typography.instructions: Import 'Cabinet Grotesk' via Fontshare or similar, and 'IBM Plex Sans' from Google Fonts in index.html. Never use Inter for headings.

colors.strategy: Archetype: The Performance Pro. A clean zinc/white base to convey transparency and trust, anchored by heavy obsidian black accents and a high-visibility 'Racing Red' brand color.
colors.guidelines: Limit primary color to CTAs (Book Appointment, Call Now) and key indicators. Use dark slate (#1A1D20) for the 'Why Rosas' section to create strong contrast and 'dark accents' as requested.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Technical shadows: `shadow-sm` or `shadow-[2px_2px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,0.9)]` for a bold, mechanic/industrial feel. Avoid soft, muddy shadows.
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the grid. Use 1px solid borders (`border-border`) on cards and containers. Do not use soft card shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: Minimal roundness. Use `rounded-none` or `rounded-sm` max to maintain a sharp, precise automotive look.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use strictly for sticky headers and the mobile bottom nav: `bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-border`.

grids_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use `py-20` or `py-24` for marketing sections. Use `p-6` or `p-8` for inner card paddings.
grids_layouts.hero: Asymmetric split layout or full-width image with strong gradient overlay (`bg-gradient-to-r from-black/80 via-black/50 to-transparent`). Do not center-align the hero text. Left align.
grids_layouts.services_grid: Bento Grid: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3` with raw HTML/Tailwind, avoiding standard Shadcn cards to allow custom hover states.
grids_layouts.booking_wizard: Low-friction stepped layout. Centered `max-w-2xl` container. High density, clean Shadcn inputs. Clear active/inactive step indicators.
grids_layouts.admin_dashboard: High-density technical grid. Sidebar layout (`w-64`) on desktop. Use Shadcn tables for booking lists, and a grid calendar view.
grids_layouts.mobile_nav: CRITICAL: Implement a fixed mobile bottom navigation (`fixed bottom-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur border-t`). Provide 4 quick actions: Home, Book, Services, Contact.

components.buttons: Industrial style. `rounded-sm` or square. Hover states must translate up slightly (`hover:-translate-y-0.5`) and shift contrast explicitly.
components.forms: Shadcn UI forms. Inputs must have clear focus rings (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:border-transparent`).
components.tables: Shadcn UI tables for the Admin dashboard. Minimal padding, zebra striping if needed for high data density.
components.dialogs: Use Shadcn Dialog for Reschedule/Cancel flows in the admin dashboard.

motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in for multi-step booking form transitions to prevent jarring jumps.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure primary red button text is pure white. Dark sections must use off-white text.
accessibility.testing: MANDATORY: Include `data-testid` attributes on all buttons, links, form inputs, and dynamic data items.

icons.style: Use 'Regular' or 'Bold' weight consistently. Avoid mixing weights.

hero_background.description: Orange classic car being repaired in garage. Evokes 'All Makes. Real Results.'

shop_exterior.description: Clean modern white and gray concrete building.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: NEVER use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients. Prioritize left-aligned text for better readability.
DO NOT apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Apply to specific properties (e.g., `transition-colors`, `transition-transform`).
DO NOT center align the app container in index.css.
Always use modern, sharp or slightly rounded button styles with explicit hover state colors.
NEVER use AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, etc.) for icons. Rely exclusively on Phosphor Icons.
Implement the mobile bottom nav utilizing `fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50`. Hide it on desktop using `md:hidden`.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals, or sticky headers. Always use solid or heavily blurred semi-solid backgrounds.
Avoid using Shadcn Cards extensively in marketing layouts. Use raw HTML/Tailwind for bento grids with 1px borders.
All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='book-now-button'`).
Prioritize optical alignment over geometric alignment. Keep the design 'Technical' and 'Precise'.
instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Add Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Sans to index.html. 2. Update Tailwind config with the specified colors and fonts. 3. Install @phosphor-icons/react. 4. Build the Marketing site (Hero, Services, Why Rosas, Contact). 5. Build the multi-step Booking flow using Shadcn forms. 6. Build the Admin Dashboard with layout, booking list, and calendar views. 7. Ensure mobile bottom nav is globally available on small screens.
